spans.text: This is that for which you were impatient [51:15] إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّـٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs [51:16] ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ Akhitheena ma atahum rabbuhum innahum kanoo qabla thalika muhsineena Accepting what their Lord has given them.

Indeed, they were before that doers of good [51:17] كَانُواْ قَلِيلٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُونَ Kanoo qaleelan mina allayli ma yahjaAAoona They used to sleep but little of the night [51:18] وَبِٱلۡأَسۡحَارِ هُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ Wabialashari hum yastaghfiroona And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness [51:19] وَفِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقّٞ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ Wafee amwalihim haqqun lilssaili waalmahroomi And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived [51:20] وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّلۡمُوقِنِينَ Wafee alardi ayatun lilmooqineena And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith] [51:21] وَفِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ Wafee anfusikum afala tubsiroona And in yourselves.

spans.text: Then will you not see [51:22] وَفِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُكُمۡ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ Wafee alssamai rizqukum wama tooAAadoona And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised [51:23] فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقّٞ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ Fawarabbi alssamai waalardi innahu lahaqqun mithla ma annakum tantiqoona Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking [51:24] هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ Hal ataka hadeethu dayfi ibraheema almukrameena Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham [51:25] إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗاۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٞ قَوۡمٞ مُّنكَرُونَ Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala salamun qawmun munkaroona When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace."

spans.text: He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown [51:26] فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلٖ سَمِينٖ Faragha ila ahlihi fajaa biAAijlin sameenin Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf [51:27] فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ Faqarrabahu ilayhim qala ala takuloona And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat [51:28] فَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةٗۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٖ Faawjasa minhum kheefatan qaloo la takhaf wabashsharoohu bighulamin AAaleemin And he felt from them apprehension.

They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy [51:29] فَأَقۡبَلَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ فِي صَرَّةٖ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٞ Faaqbalati imraatuhu fee sarratin fasakkat wajhaha waqalat AAajoozun AAaqeemun And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman [51:30] قَالُواْ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ Qaloo kathaliki qala rabbuki innahu huwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing [51:31] ۞قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers [51:32] قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ مُّجۡرِمِينَ Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals [51:33] لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةٗ مِّن طِينٖ Linursila AAalayhim hijaratan min teenin To send down upon them stones of clay [51:34] مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ Musawwamatan AAinda rabbika lilmusrifeena Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors [51:35] فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ Faakhrajna man kana feeha mina almumineena So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers [51:36] فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتٖ مِّنَ بِرُكۡنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٞ Fatawalla biruknihi waqala sahirun aw majnoonun But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman [51:40] فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ
